Do not credit these as independent original constructions.' Its table gives each side rounded upward at 12 places: 130 11.902430645983, 299 17.801004434255, 303 17.901789273154, 553 23.969145238668, 599 24.936479681246, 600 24.951090275321, 601 24.958070476928, 602 24.981298949631, 604 24.995880488226, 645 25.881385537401, 647 25.899272968790, 648 25.908803576981, 699 26.907311118315, 700 26.908036102718, and says the exact rational side in each certificate and manifest is authoritative.

Each certificate is in Evan Daniel's format: a comment line, the header 'n S' with S an exact fraction, then n rows 'x y t', a rational centre and the rational tangent of each unit square's half-angle. The comment lines name the lineage: n130 'exact envelope tightening only; Mishapolk after Francisco Couzo and PR574 contributors source lineage'; n299 'Doğa Özden after Evan Daniel / Chris Deotte source lineage'; n303 'v32 no-strain control refinement; Doğa Özden after Evan Daniel / Chris Deotte / Griffin Casson source lineage'; n604 'Couzo / alexchilton fault-line-dp-basin-hopping source lineage'; the other ten 'Couzo / Lavrentev source lineage'. The comments' word 'private' describes the files' state before publication, as PACKINGS.md says.

(upward to 16 places: 11.9024306459822463), approximately 1.9554409882111e-14 below the source certificate. Packing credit remains Mishapolk after Francisco Couzo and PR574 contributors; not a new arrangement.'
